deviation: Ownership of Deliverables only passes to Arcadia upon payment of Fees, so a fee dispute could leave Arcadia without title. The "Vertex Tools" definition is also very broad (includes methodologies and generally applicable know-how) and the licence is limited to use "as necessary" for business purposes, which could carve bespoke work out of Arcadia's ownership and restrict its use. Clause 6.1 also says Arcadia "retains" rights in its data but does not clearly state that Arcadia owns all Customer Data.
suggested_text: 6.1 Arcadia owns all Customer Data and all Confidential Information of Arcadia, and nothing in this Agreement transfers any rights in them to Vertex. 6.2 Vertex assigns to Arcadia, with effect from creation, all right, title and interest in all Deliverables created specifically for Arcadia, excluding only Vertex Tools. Ownership of the Deliverables is not conditional on payment of Fees. 6.3 "Vertex Tools" means Vertex's generic, pre-existing tools, software and methodologies that were developed independently of this Agreement and are not specific to Arcadia, and which Vertex identifies in writing. Vertex retains ownership of Vertex Tools and grants Arcadia a non-exclusive, perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, transferable (to Affiliates and successors) licence to use, copy and modify Vertex Tools incorporated into the Deliverables for the purpose of using, maintaining and enhancing the Deliverables for Arcadia's and its Affiliates' business purposes. Vertex Tools do not include any Customer Data or any element of the Deliverables created specifically for Arcadia.
